findings.summary: Call-boundary crash recovery is partial: a crash after next_goal_call writes RECORD_CALL but before finish_goal_call writes RECORD_CALL_RESULT leaves restore() holding a reconstructed in-flight fence (inflight[goal]=call_id) with no release path, so that goal stays fenced forever. This only materialises around a live ReAct call interruption, which the spec defers ('real runtime recovery / runtime crash adoption' in Deferred verification and the joint phase); the required development-acceptance coverage is 'crash before/after effect receipt' (implemented and tested in TestCrashBoundary), not call-level crash. Noted as out-of-scope, not blocking.
